problem.title: How can I dynamically log as the program runs?
problem.description: My logging creates a StreamWriter and FileStream : //Activate Logging try { streamer = new FileStream("filepath and name", FileMode.OpenOrCreate, FileAccess.Write); writer = new StreamWriter(streamer); } I use parameters to create the file name. If an error occurs before this file is created I create another file called "crashlog", which logs the error itself. However, this file is sometimes empty.
